description: Shared test vectors for the body of a card or a comment: documents and what the server and the web app's validator must do with them. expect is accept (stored as sent), empty (stored as no body) or reject; a rejection names its kind in reason: notDocument, tooLarge, tooDeep, tooManyNodes, tooManyBoardViews, tableTooLarge, invalidNode. An accepted case may give text, the plain text the server stores for searching : a line per paragraph, heading, code block and formula block, the lines of blocks without words left out; a hard break is a line break kept inside its block's line, a formula inside a line gives its source there, a table gives the lines of its cells row after row, a toggle (details) gives its summary as a line and then the lines of what it hides, and a mention, a reference and a board view give nothing. Whole numbers count however they are written (1, 1.0, 1e0). Lengths are UTF-16 code units. The limits of depth (60), nodes (100,000) and size (8 MiB) are tested with documents each side builds from a case's build, which stands for body: {depth: n} is a document nesting n deep (doc, then n-2 blockquotes, then an empty paragraph); {nodes: n} is a document of n nodes (doc, then one paragraph of n-2 hardBreaks); {bytes: n} is a document of one paragraph of one text of the letter a, as long as makes its JSON without whitespace n bytes of UTF-8; {rows: n, columns: m} is a document of one table of n rows of m cells, each cell an empty paragraph. A table has at most 200 rows and 20 columns (its cells' spans across a row): past them is tableTooLarge. The server's test is crates/model/tests/body_vectors.rs. Either side that finds the two disagree adds a case. The allowlist is crates/model/src/allowlist.rs on the server and apps/web/src/lib/editor/schema.ts in the web app; bodyVersion is the version of it the cases are written for.
